title: Amelia | Shirt dress with front buttons
bodyHtml:
Effortless from morning to evening. The Amelia is the shirt dress every Australian woman needs—flattering, versatile, and honestly just makes you feel put-together. With classic front buttons, adjustable straps, and a fluid silhouette that skims beautifully, it works equally well for a relaxed weekend or a lunch out. Throw it on and you're done.

Why you'll love it

  • Flattering fit that skims without clinging — tailored to work for every body shape and size
  • Classic front button detail — timeless, elegant, and easy to adjust the neckline to suit you
  • Adjustable shoulder straps — personalised comfort that actually fits *your* frame
  • Practical front pockets — because function never goes out of fashion
  • Deep, rich colour that suits every skin tone — sophisticated and easy to style
  • Available in sizes S to 2XL — designed to make every figure feel confident
  • All-day comfort — move from casual to smart without thinking twice

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
